policy: Official semantic subtype bridge for current CUATM administrative UATs. CUATM supplies legal identity, hierarchy and status codes; Law 764/2001 supplies the exhaustive municipality set and the legal distinction between level-I and level-II municipalities. OSM tags/admin_level are not legal subtype evidence.

sources.authority: Biroul Național de Statistică al Republicii Moldova
sources.label: CUATM current Excel
Legea nr. 764/2001 privind organizarea administrativ-teritorială, text consolidat

status_5.level_2_municipality: status_code=5 identity whose official name is exactly one of the exhaustive level-II municipality set: Chișinău, Bălți.
status_5.level_1_municipality: Any other status_code=5 identity, after proving the complete status_code=5 population equals the exhaustive current municipality set.
status_5.fail_closed: Any missing, duplicate, unexpected or cross-status municipality identity blocks the bridge.

status_3.rule: Every current CUATM status_code=3 identity is a town. Municipality status is represented by status_code=5 and is validated separately against Law 764/2001; OSM admin_level/place is not used.

status_8.commune: status_code=8 with one or more direct CUATM children, all of status_code=9.
status_8.independent_village: status_code=8 with zero direct CUATM children.
status_8.fail_closed: Any status_code=8 child whose status_code is not 9, duplicate code, broken parent reference or unclassified structure is blocking.

settlement_policy_separation: CUATM status_code 6/9 component localities are intentionally outside this bridge. Their polygon-exhaustiveness policy remains separately NOT_DETERMINED.
